sentences.text: Stoicism is a philosophical movement and practical guide to living, emphasizing daily self-discipline and moral improvement, which originated in the Hellenistic period of ancient Greece and continued well into the Roman Imperial period.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: a philosophical movement and practical guide to living

relativeClauses.text: which originated in the Hellenistic period of ancient Greece and continued well into the Roman Imperial period

subordinateClauses.text: emphasizing daily self-discipline and moral improvement

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干是 Stoicism is a philosophical movement and practical guide。emphasizing ... 是现在分词补充说明；which 引导非限制性定语从句，交代这一哲学运动的起源与延续。originated 与 continued 在从句中并列。

sentences.text: The ancient Stoics believed that the universe operated according to reason, or logos, providing a unified account of the world, constructed from ideals of rational discourse, monistic physics, and naturalistic ethics.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: that the universe operated according to reason, or logos, providing a unified account of the world,
providing a unified account of the world
constructed from ideals of rational discourse, monistic physics, and naturalistic ethics

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 The ancient Stoics believed that ...，that 后是信念的内容。reason, or logos 中的 or 是换一种说法；providing ... 补充这套思想对世界的解释，constructed from ... 说明这一解释的思想基础。

sentences.text: These ideals constitute virtue, which is necessary for the Stoic goal of 'living a well-reasoned life'.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

objectsOrComplements.text: virtue, which is necessary for the Stoic goal of 'living a well-reasoned life

relativeClauses.text: which is necessary for the Stoic goal of 'living a well-reasoned life

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 These ideals constitute virtue，constitute 表示“构成”。which 引导非限制性定语从句，指向 virtue；of 后的 living a well-reasoned life 是动名词短语，说明目标的内容。

sentences.text: Stoic philosophy is traditionally divided into three interconnected disciplines: logic, physics, and ethics.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语是 Stoic philosophy；is divided into 是被动谓语，traditionally 插在助动词和分词之间。冒号后的 logic, physics, and ethics 具体列出 three interconnected disciplines。

existingAnnotation.text: Stoic philosophy is traditionally divided into three interconnected disciplines: logic, physics, and ethics.
existingAnnotation.translation: 传统上，斯多葛哲学被划分为三个相互联系的领域：逻辑学、物理学和伦理学。
existingAnnotation.analysis: 主干 Stoic philosophy is divided into 使用被动语态，表示“被划分为”。traditionally 作状语；interconnected 修饰 disciplines；冒号后列举三个领域。
existingAnnotation.label: 原有整句译文与讲解（AI 编写）

sourceSpan.text: Stoic philosophy is traditionally divided into three interconnected disciplines: logic, physics, and ethics.

sentences.text: Stoic logic focuses on highly intentional reasoning through propositions, arguments, and the differentiation between truth and falsehood.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Stoic logic focuses on ...，on 后是它关注的推理。through 后并列 propositions、arguments 和 the differentiation；between truth and falsehood 说明 differentiation 区分的两端。

sentences.text: Philosophical discourse is paramount in Stoicism, including the view that the mind is in rational dialogue with itself.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: that the mind is in rational dialogue with itself

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Philosophical discourse is paramount。including the view ... 补充一项观点；that the mind is in rational dialogue with itself 解释 view 的具体内容，是同位语性质的内容从句，that 不在从句中充当主语或宾语。

sentences.text: Stoic ethics centers on virtue as the highest good, cultivating emotional self-control, a calm problem-solving state of mind, and rational judgment to attain lifelong flourishing (eudaimonia).
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: cultivating emotional self-control, a calm problem-solving state of mind, and rational judgment to attain lifelong flourishing (eudaimonia)

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Stoic ethics centers on virtue，centers 在这里是动词，center on 表示“以……为中心”。as the highest good 说明 virtue 的地位；cultivating 后并列三项培养内容，to attain ... 表示目的。

sentences.text: At the same time, passions, anxieties, and insecurities are viewed as misguided reactions that ought to be controlled through self-disciplined practice.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

relativeClauses.text: that ought to be controlled through self-disciplined practice

subordinateClauses.text: to be controlled through self-disciplined practice

sentences.readingHintZh: 主语由 passions、anxieties、insecurities 三项组成，are viewed as 表示“被视为”。that 引导修饰 reactions 的定语从句，ought to be controlled 表示这些反应应当受到控制。

sentences.text: Of all the schools of ancient Western philosophy, Stoicism made the greatest claim to being utterly systematic.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: Of all the schools ... 给出比较范围。主干是 Stoicism made the greatest claim；claim to 中的 to 是介词，因此后接 being utterly systematic，表示自称或主张具有彻底的系统性。

sentences.text: Central to Stoic ethics was the idea of living in accordance with nature, which meant aligning one's life with one's sense of reason and the rational order of the universe.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: the idea of living in accordance with nature, which meant aligning one's life with one's sense of reason and the rational order of the universe

relativeClauses.text: which meant aligning one's life with one's sense of reason and the rational order of the universe

subordinateClauses.text: aligning one's life with one's sense of reason and the rational order of the universe

sentences.readingHintZh: 这是表语前置的倒装句。还原后为 The idea of living in accordance with nature was central to Stoic ethics；the idea ... 才是主语。which 后补充说明这一思想的含义，align ... with ... 表示“使……与……一致”。

sentences.text: Stoicism was founded in the ancient Agora of Athens by Zeno of Citium around 300 BCE, and flourished throughout the Greco-Roman world until the 3rd century CE.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语 Stoicism 先接被动谓语 was founded，再接主动谓语 flourished，二者由 and 连接。by 引出创立者；around 与 until 分别提示创立的大致时间和兴盛延续的终点。

sentences.text: Stoicism emerged from the Cynic tradition and was popularized through public teaching at the Stoa Poikile, a painted colonnade.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主干为 Stoicism emerged ... and was popularized ...，同一主语连接主动与被动两部分。from 表示传统来源，through 表示传播方式；a painted colonnade 是 Stoa Poikile 的同位语。

sentences.text: Among its adherents was Roman Emperor Marcus Aurelius.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 句首 Among its adherents 使句子倒装；正常语序是 Roman Emperor Marcus Aurelius was among its adherents。主语是这位罗马皇帝，its 指斯多葛主义。

sentences.text: Along with Aristotelian term logic, the system of propositional logic developed by the Stoics was one of the two great systems of logic in the classical world.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subjects.text: the system of propositional logic developed by the Stoics

objectsOrComplements.text: one of the two great systems of logic in the classical world

sentences.readingHintZh: 先略过句首 Along with ...，主干是 the system ... was one of the two great systems。developed by the Stoics 是过去分词短语，后置修饰 system；along with 不把 term logic 变成并列主语。

sentences.text: It was largely built and shaped by Chrysippus, the third head of the Stoic school in the 3rd century BCE.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: It 指上一句的命题逻辑体系。was built and shaped 是两个共享 was 的被动谓语；by 后的 Chrysippus 是行动者，逗号后的 the third head ... 是其身份的同位语说明。

sentences.text: Chrysippus's logic differed from term logic because it was based on the analysis of propositions rather than terms.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: because it was based on the analysis of propositions rather than terms

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Chrysippus's logic differed from term logic。because 引导原因状语从句；was based on 表示“以……为基础”，rather than 连接 propositions 与 terms，突出分析对象的差别。

sentences.text: Stoicism experienced a decline after Christianity became the state religion in the 4th century CE, although Gnosticism lingered and incorporated elements of Stoicism and Platonism.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误

subordinateClauses.text: after Christianity became the state religion in the 4th century CE
although Gnosticism lingered and incorporated elements of Stoicism and Platonism

sentences.readingHintZh: 主干 Stoicism experienced a decline。after 引导时间状语从句，although 引导让步状语从句；后者的主语 Gnosticism 同时支配 lingered 与 incorporated，注意不要把这两个动作归给 Stoicism。

sentences.text: Since then, it has seen revivals, notably in the Renaissance (Neostoicism) and in the contemporary era.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: Since then 表示“自那以后”，与现在完成时 has seen 呼应。it 指斯多葛主义，seen revivals 表示经历复兴；notably 后的两个 in 短语指出尤其显著的时期。

sentences.text: Its influence extended to Roman thinkers like Seneca and Epictetus and later influenced Christianity and the Renaissance Neostoicism movement.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语是 Its influence，extended 与 influenced 由第二个 and 连接，共用该主语。like Seneca and Epictetus 举例说明 Roman thinkers；最后一个 and 连接两个受到影响的对象。

sentences.text: Stoicism shaped subsequent developments in logic and inspired modern cognitive therapies.
sentences.label: 自动句法提示 · 非整句翻译 · 可能有误
sentences.readingHintZh: 主语 Stoicism 对应两个并列谓语 shaped 和 inspired。前者的宾语是 subsequent developments in logic，后者的宾语是 modern cognitive therapies；不要把 and 后误读成另一个主语。
